about.description: Official Python library for the DeepL language translation API.
about.head: 60c679c

name: v1.33.0
body:
TL;DR: new APIs in this release: the Admin API, spoken terms and style profiles.
Translation memories, style rules and multilingual glossaries gained many options and fixes.
Read Changed and Deprecated before upgrading; no public API is removed in this release.

### Added
- Added the `headers` option to the `Translator`, `DeepLClient` and
  `DeepLAdminClient` constructors: extra HTTP headers sent with every request
  to the DeepL API. A header replaces the library's header of the same name,
  including `User-Agent` and `Authorization`; `Content-Type`,
  `Content-Length`, `Transfer-Encoding`, `Host` and an `Accept` the library
  sets for a call keep the library's value. Translation memory storage URLs
  get only the `User-Agent`.
- Added the `app_info` option, an `AppInfo(app_name, app_version)`, to the
  `Translator`, `DeepLClient` and `DeepLAdminClient` constructors, the same as
  calling `set_app_info()`.
- Added `NotFoundException`, raised for HTTP 404 on every endpoint.
  `GlossaryNotFoundException` is now its subclass.
- Added `is_free_account_auth_key()`, which replaces `auth_key_is_free_account()`.
- Added the `extra_body_parameters` option to `create_style_rule()`,
  `update_style_rule_name()`, `update_style_rule_configured_rules()`,
  `create_style_rule_custom_instruction()` and
  `update_style_rule_custom_instruction()`.
- `get_style_rule_custom_instruction()`,
  `update_style_rule_custom_instruction()` and
  `delete_style_rule_custom_instruction()` accept a `CustomInstruction` object
  as `instruction_id`, as well as an ID string.
- Added the `max_retries` and `timeout_s` options to the `Translator`,
  `DeepLClient` and `DeepLAdminClient` constructors, to set the maximum number
  of retries and the minimum per-attempt timeout in seconds for each client.
- Added the `style_profile` option to `translate_text()` and the document
  translation functions (`translate_document()`,
  `translate_document_from_filepath()`, `translate_document_upload()`) to
  translate with a style profile, as a style profile ID or `StyleProfile`
  object. The CLI accepts it as `--style-profile-id`.
- Added the `DeepLAdminClient` class for the Admin API. It must be created with
  an admin API key and supports managing developer keys
  (`create_developer_key()`, `list_developer_keys()`,
  `deactivate_developer_key()`, `rename_developer_key()`,
  `set_developer_key_usage_limits()`) and retrieving usage analytics
  (`get_usage_analytics()`, `get_custom_tag_usage_analytics()`) with
  the result types `DeveloperKey`, `DeveloperKeyUsageLimits`,
  `AdminUsageReport`, `AdminUsageBreakdown`, `KeyUsage`, `CustomTagUsageReport`,
  `CustomTagUsage` and `CustomTagUsageBreakdown`, and the request options
  `DeveloperKeyUsageLimitsUpdate`, `AdminUsageGroupBy` and
  `CustomTagUsageAggregateBy`.
  The developer key methods that send a request body accept
  `extra_body_parameters`.
  `create_developer_key()` is retried only when the request was not sent:
  after HTTP 429, a DNS resolution failure, a refused connection or a connect
  timeout. `AdminUsageReport.total_usage`,
  `AdminUsageBreakdown.speech_to_speech_minutes` and
  `CustomTagUsageBreakdown.speech_to_speech_minutes` are `None` when the
  report does not contain them, and a response without `usage_report` or
  `custom_tag_usage_report` raises `DeepLException`.
- Added `get_languages_for_resource()` method to the `DeepLClient` class to
  retrieve the languages supported by a resource, with per-feature support
  information, via the `/v3/languages` endpoint. Resources are given as
  `LanguageResourceName` values or strings; results are `LanguageSupport`
  objects. Malformed responses raise `DeepLException`.
- Added `get_language_resources()` method to the `DeepLClient` class to
  retrieve the API resources and their features via the
  `/v3/languages/resources` endpoint. Results are returned as
  `LanguageResource` and `ResourceFeature` objects; `needs_source_support`
  and `needs_target_support` are `False` when the API omits them.
- Added `Language` constants for the target variants `de-CH`, `de-DE`,
  `es-ES`, `fr-CA`, and `fr-FR`.
- Added the `enable_watermark` option to `translate_document()`,
  `translate_document_upload()` and `translate_document_from_filepath()`. Set
  it to `True` to add a "Translated by DeepL" watermark to `docx` and `pdf`
  output.
- Added the API Pro usage fields to `Usage`: `api_key_character`,
  `speech_to_text_minutes` and `speech_to_speech_minutes` (as
  `Optional[Usage.Detail]`), `start_time` and `end_time` (the billing period),
  and `products`, a list of `Usage.Product` objects with per-product usage.
  They are `None` when the response does not contain them; `products` entries
  that are not JSON objects are skipped.
- Added the Spoken Terms API (`/v3/spoken-terms`) to the `DeepLClient` class:
  `create_spoken_terms()`, `list_spoken_terms()`, `get_spoken_terms()`,
  `update_spoken_terms()`, `get_spoken_terms_entries()`,
  `replace_spoken_terms_list()`, `delete_spoken_terms()` and
  `delete_spoken_terms_list()`, with the `SpokenTerms`, `SpokenTermsList` and
  `SpokenTermsEntries` types. `create_spoken_terms()`, `update_spoken_terms()`
  and `replace_spoken_terms_list()` accept `extra_body_parameters`. Collection
  IDs are URL-encoded in the request path, terms are stripped of leading and
  trailing whitespace before they are validated and sent, and a malformed
  response raises `DeepLException`.
- Added the style profile API (`/v3/style_profiles`) to the `DeepLClient`
  class: `list_style_profiles()`, `create_style_profile()`,
  `get_style_profile()`, `update_style_profile()` and
  `delete_style_profile()`, with the `StyleProfile` type. The `glossary_ids`,
  `style_rule_ids` and `translation_memory_ids` options of
  `create_style_profile()` and `update_style_profile()` accept IDs or
  `GlossaryInfo`, `MultilingualGlossaryInfo`, `StyleRuleInfo` and
  `TranslationMemoryInfo` objects, and both functions accept
  `extra_body_parameters`. A style profile response that is not a JSON object,
  or lacks a valid `style_profile_id`, `name`, `creation_time` or
  `updated_time`, raises `DeepLException`.
- Added the `TagHandlingMode` (`HTML`, `XML`) and `TagHandlingVersion` (`V1`,
  `V2`) enums. The `tag_handling` and `tag_handling_version` options of
  `translate_text()` accept them as well as strings.
- Added `tag_handling_version` to `TextResult`: the tag handling version the
  API used, or `None` when the response does not contain it.
- `translate_text()` accepts `source_lang` and `target_lang` positionally after
  the text, for example `translate_text("Hello", None, "DE")`. Keyword use is
  unchanged; omitting `target_lang` still raises `TypeError`.
- Added the `document_id` property to `DocumentStatus`, read from the status
  response of `translate_document_get_status()` (falling back to the handle's
  document ID).
- `translate_document()`, `translate_document_from_filepath()` and
  `translate_document_upload()` now also accept `source_lang` and
  `target_lang` as positional arguments after the input (and output)
  arguments, for example `translate_document_upload(file, "EN", "DE")`.
  Keyword use is unchanged.
- Added the `writing_style` and `extra_body_parameters` options to
  `rephrase_text()`, and the `extra_body_parameters` option to
  `correct_text()`. `writing_style` and `tone` accept a `WritingStyle` or
  `WritingTone` member or a string.
- Added `update_multilingual_glossary()` to the `DeepLClient` class to rename a
  multilingual glossary and/or merge dictionaries into it in one request,
  sending only the options that are set.
- Added `get_multilingual_glossary_dictionary_entries()` to the `DeepLClient`
  class, returning the `MultilingualGlossaryDictionaryEntries` of one dictionary
  and raising `GlossaryNotFoundException` if the glossary has none for the
  language pair.
- Added the `extra_body_parameters` option to `create_multilingual_glossary()`,
  `create_multilingual_glossary_from_csv()`,
  `update_multilingual_glossary_name()`,
  `update_multilingual_glossary_dictionary()`,
  `update_multilingual_glossary_dictionary_from_csv()`,
  `replace_multilingual_glossary_dictionary()` and
  `replace_multilingual_glossary_dictionary_from_csv()`.
- `get_multilingual_glossary()` accepts a `MultilingualGlossaryInfo` object, as
  `glossary`, besides a glossary ID.
- Added the argument names `dictionaries` (`create_multilingual_glossary()`),
  `dictionary` (`update_multilingual_glossary_dictionary()`,
  `replace_multilingual_glossary_dictionary()`), `csv` (the
  `*_multilingual_glossary*_from_csv()` functions) and `glossary`
  (`get_multilingual_glossary()`).
- `MultilingualGlossaryInfo`, `MultilingualGlossaryDictionaryInfo` and
  `MultilingualGlossaryDictionaryEntries` are exported from the `deepl` package.
- Added `MultilingualGlossaryDictionaryInfo.to_json()`.
- Added the `content_type` and `extra_body_parameters` options to
  `import_translation_memory_from_filepath()`, and the `extra_body_parameters`
  option to `create_translation_memory_import()`. `content_type` is declared
  when creating the import job and sent with the upload; extra body parameters
  are added to the request that creates the import job and replace keys of
  the same name.
- Added the `TranslationMemoryJobStatus` enum. `TranslationMemoryJob.status`
  and `TranslationMemoryJobResult.status` now return its members for the
  statuses `awaiting_input`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed` and
  `expired`, and the plain string for any other value. Members are strings
  that compare equal to the API value, so existing comparisons with strings
  and the `TranslationMemoryJobResult.STATUS_*` constants keep working.
- Added the `content` parameter name to `upload_translation_memory_file()`
  for the file content, replacing `input_file`. Positional calls are
  unaffected.
- `DocumentTranslationException` accepts `should_retry` and
  `http_status_code`. `translate_document()` and
  `translate_document_from_filepath()` copy both from the underlying
  `DeepLException`; before they were always `False` and `None`.

### Changed
- With `timeout_s`, `wait_until_translation_memory_job_done()` now cuts its
  last sleep short; previously it could run up to 5 seconds past the timeout.
- `import_translation_memory_from_filepath()` now reads the file and
  `export_translation_memory_to_filepath()` now checks the output path before
  creating the job, so these `OSError`s are raised without creating a job;
  previously the job was created first.
- `translate_text()` now accepts `glossary` and `glossary_ids` without
  `source_lang`, and DeepL uses the glossary dictionary for the detected
  language pair; previously it raised `ValueError`. Document translation with a
  glossary still requires `source_lang`.
- A path in `server_url` is now kept; previously the last path segment was
  dropped.
- HTTP 401 responses now raise `AuthorizationException`; previously
  `DeepLException`.
- Creating a `Translator` now emits a `DeprecationWarning`; previously it did
  not.
- HTTP 404 responses raise `NotFoundException` instead of `DeepLException`
  (glossary functions keep raising `GlossaryNotFoundException`, now a
  subclass of `NotFoundException`).
- The `User-Agent` platform information now ends with `python/<version>`;
  previously it also included the `requests` version.
- Target languages `EN` and `PT` are now sent to the API, which translates them
  into `EN-US` and `PT-PT`; previously they were rejected client-side.
- `get_source_languages()`, `get_target_languages()`, and
  `get_glossary_languages()` now use the `/v3/languages` endpoint
  internally instead of the deprecated `/v2/languages` and
  `/v2/glossary-language-pairs` endpoints. Public signatures and return
  types are unchanged, but the returned language lists may now include
  additional languages.
- The default `chunk_size` of `translate_document_download()` and
  `download_translation_memory_export()` is now 64 KiB instead of 1 byte, so
  downloads into `output_file` no longer write one byte per call. The written
  content is unchanged; an explicit `chunk_size` still applies.
- `DocumentStatus.status` is now typed `Union[DocumentStatus.Status, str]`: a
  status value the API returns that this version does not know is kept as a
  string instead of raising `ValueError`. Type-checked code that reads
  `status.status.value` may need an `isinstance(..., DocumentStatus.Status)`
  guard; `str(status)` returns the status string in both cases.

### Deprecated
- `Translator` is deprecated in favour of `DeepLClient`, which supports all its
  functions, and will be removed in the next major version.
- `GlossaryNotFoundException` is deprecated, catch `NotFoundException` instead.
  It will be removed in the next major version.
- `auth_key_is_free_account()` is deprecated, use `is_free_account_auth_key()`.
  Calling it emits a `DeprecationWarning`.
- The module-level setting `deepl.http_client.user_agent` is deprecated in
  favour of a `User-Agent` entry in the `headers` option, and will be removed in
  the next major version. Assigning it emits a `DeprecationWarning`.
- Calling `translate_document_download()` or
  `download_translation_memory_export()` without `output_file` now emits a
  `DeprecationWarning`. It still returns the streaming `requests.Response`; in
  the next major version `output_file` will be required and both methods will
  return `None`.
- Passing `skip_language_check` to `Translator()` or `DeepLClient()`, or
  `skip_cache` to `get_source_languages()` or `get_target_languages()`, now
  emits a `DeprecationWarning`. Both parameters have no effect and will be
  removed in the next major version. Their defaults changed from `False` to
  `None`; passing `False` explicitly also warns.
- The module-level settings `deepl.http_client.max_network_retries` and
  `deepl.http_client.min_connection_timeout` are deprecated in favour of the
  `max_retries` and `timeout_s` client options, and will be removed in the
  next major version. They still apply to clients created without these
  options. Assigning either setting emits a `DeprecationWarning`.
- The language code constants of `Language` (`Language.GERMAN`,
  `Language.ENGLISH_AMERICAN`, ...) are deprecated and will be removed in the
  next major version. Pass language codes as strings, for example `"de"`, or
  use the codes returned by `get_source_languages()` and
  `get_target_languages()`. The constants keep working and emit no warning.
- The `style` keyword of `rephrase_text()` is deprecated in favour of
  `writing_style` and emits a `DeprecationWarning`. It keeps working; if both
  are given, `writing_style` is used.
- `get_multilingual_glossary_entries()` is deprecated, use
  `get_multilingual_glossary_dictionary_entries()`.
- The argument names `glossary_dicts`, `glossary_dict`, `csv_data` and
  `glossary_id` of the multilingual glossary functions are deprecated, use
  `dictionaries`, `dictionary`, `csv` and `glossary`.
- The `input_file` keyword of `upload_translation_memory_file()` is
  deprecated in favour of `content` and will be removed in the next major
  version. Passing it emits a `DeprecationWarning`.
- `SplitSentences.DEFAULT` is deprecated, use `SplitSentences.ALL`, which it is
  an alias of.
- `translate_text_with_glossary()` is deprecated, use `translate_text()` with
  the `glossary` parameter. Calling it emits a `DeprecationWarning`.

### Fixed
- A glossary CSV row without a target term now raises a `ValueError` naming
  the row; previously a bare `IndexError` (it is still an `IndexError`).
- A connection that is reset or breaks off while a non-streamed response body
  is read is now retried like other connection failures, and raises
  `ConnectionException` with `should_retry` `True` once retries are used up.
  `create_developer_key()` is still not retried after it.
- `translate_document_download()` now streams the translated document to
  `output_file` in chunks, instead of first reading the whole document into
  memory for the debug log.
- A connection reset or timeout while `translate_document_download()` or
  `download_translation_memory_export()` reads the downloaded file now raises
  `ConnectionException`, instead of a `requests` exception.
- HTTP 3xx responses that are not followed as redirects (e.g. 300, 304, or a
  redirect without `Location`) now raise `DeepLException` with
  `http_status_code`, instead of being parsed as a successful response.
- TLS and certificate failures, and proxy failures (including a failure to
  connect to the proxy), are no longer retried and raise `ConnectionException`
  with `should_retry` `False`.
- Query string values encode a space as `%20` instead of `+`.
- Fixed errors from the pre-signed translation memory upload and download URLs
  reporting `should_retry` as [secure] for HTTP 429 and 5xx, and dropping the
  response body of a failed download from the message.
- A failed `export_translation_memory_to_filepath()` no longer leaves a
  partially written file behind.
- `DeepLException.should_retry` is now `True` for every HTTP 5xx error. It was
  `False` for all of them except 503, although they are retried.
- An error response whose `message` or `detail` is not a string (a number,
  object or `null`) no longer raises `TypeError`; the value is included as
  JSON, `null` is left out.
- Leading and trailing whitespace in the authentication key is removed before
  it is sent and before the `:fx` check that selects the API Free server. A
  key of only whitespace is rejected with `ValueError`.
- Fixed `translate_text()` raising `TypeError` when a translation in the
  response has no `billed_characters`. `TextResult.billed_characters` is now
  `None` in that case.
- Fixed `translate_text()` raising `IndexError` when the response holds fewer
  translations than texts sent. It now raises `DeepLException`.
- Fixed `translate_document_get_status()` raising `ValueError` and
  `translate_document_wait_until_done()` stopping when the API returns a
  document status this version does not know. `DocumentStatus.status` keeps
  such a status as a string, and polling continues.
- Fixed `translate_document()` and `translate_document_from_filepath()`
  sending `formality=default` when `formality` was not set. It is now sent
  only when given.
- Fixed `translate_document_get_status()` and `translate_document_download()`
  not URL-encoding the document ID in the request path.
- Fixed `translate_document_upload()` returning an empty `DocumentHandle` when
  the response lacks `document_id` or `document_key`, and raising
  `AttributeError` when the response body is not a JSON object. Both now
  raise `DeepLException`.
- Fixed the type annotation of `DocumentStatus.error_message`, which is a
  string, not an integer.
- Fixed the style rule functions inserting the style rule ID and custom
  instruction ID into the request path without escaping them, so an ID
  containing `/`, `?` or `#` addressed a different resource.
- Fixed the style rule functions raising a raw `KeyError`, `ValueError`,
  `TypeError` or `AttributeError` on a malformed `StyleRuleInfo` or
  `CustomInstruction` response. They now raise `DeepLException`.
- Fixed the `DeprecationWarning` messages of `Usage.Detail.limit_exceeded` and
  `Usage.any_limit_exceeded`, which named the replacement instead of the
  deprecated property. They now read "limit_exceeded is deprecated, use
  limit_reached" and "any_limit_exceeded is deprecated, use any_limit_reached".
- Fixed the `Language.ENGLISH` and `Language.PORTUGUESE` comments that
  claimed they are only usable as source languages.
- Fixed `create_glossary_from_csv()` failing with "Object of type bytes is not
  JSON serializable" when the CSV data is given as bytes or as a file opened in
  binary mode.
- Fixed the `rephrase` CLI command always failing with an unexpected keyword
  argument error. `--show-detected-source` now prints the detected source
  language of each text.
- Fixed the `translate` CLI alias of the `text` command failing with
  `'action_translate'`.
- Fixed the `extra_body_parameters` documentation, which claimed that entries
  do not overwrite request fields set by the library. They do, since 1.24.0.
- Fixed `MultilingualGlossaryInfo.to_json()` raising `TypeError` when called on
  an instance.
- Fixed `rephrase_text()` and `correct_text()` failing with "Object of type
  ... is not JSON serializable" when `target_lang` is a `Language` object or
  the style or tone is a `WritingStyle` or `WritingTone` member. The value is
  now sent as its string code.
- `rephrase_text()` and `correct_text()` now raise `DeepLException` when the
  response has no `improvements` list, fewer improvements than input texts, or
  an improvement without `text`. Before, this raised `IndexError` or
  `AttributeError`, or silently returned a shorter list.
- `get_source_languages()` and `get_target_languages()` now raise
  `DeepLException` when the response is not a list (they returned an empty
  list before) or a language in it is missing its code or name (instead of a
  raw `KeyError`, `AttributeError` or `TypeError`). A null `features` field is
  treated as no features.
- Glossary IDs are URL-encoded in `/v3/glossaries` request paths, and the
  language pair in the query of `get_multilingual_glossary_entries()` and
  `delete_multilingual_glossary_dictionary()` is URL-encoded.
  `delete_multilingual_glossary_dictionary()` now also strips regional variants
  (`EN-GB` becomes `EN`), like the other multilingual glossary functions.
- A malformed multilingual glossary response raises `DeepLException` instead of
  a raw `KeyError`, `TypeError` or `ValueError`.
- `MultilingualGlossaryInfo.to_json()` returns a JSON-serialisable dictionary:
  `creation_time` as an ISO 8601 string and `dictionaries` as dictionaries.
- Fixed the translation memory functions sending translation memory and job
  IDs unencoded in the request path. IDs are now URL-encoded, so characters
  such as `/`, `?` or spaces no longer change the requested URL.
- Fixed the translation memory functions raising a raw `KeyError`,
  `TypeError` or `AttributeError` when the API returns a malformed response.
  They now raise `DeepLException`. `list_translation_memories()` also raises
  `DeepLException` for a non-JSON response instead of returning an empty list.
- Fixed `get_usage()` returning a `Usage` with every value invalid when the
  response body is not a JSON object. It now raises `DeepLException`.
- `translate_document_download()` now raises errors with the API's error
  message. Before, a 400, 404 or 456 response raised without it, and other
  statuses reported `content: <file>`.
- `translate_document_wait_until_done()` (and `translate_document()` with
  `timeout_s`) shortens its last wait to the timeout, so it no longer runs up
  to 5 seconds past `timeout_s`.
